scientific_integrity: The 2022 general minimality criterion, the published count for the five-cycle, and the pre-existing univariate integer sequence are credited. No novelty is claimed for those results.
scientific_limitations: Exact for simple labeled cycles of order at least three and pointwise-minimal Roman functions. The univariate coefficient sequence already occurs as a Fielder sequence (Plouffe, 1992), without the asserted graph interpretation. Earlier unindexed bivariate enumerations cannot be excluded. Finite computational checks are not infinite proof; the gap-determinant derivation supplies the proof. Independent review has not been performed.
title: Bivariate census of pointwise-minimal Roman dominating functions on cycles
